m_74e1825008: Each game day includes 24 hourly water calculations. Growing from 50 g to market size takes months. m_8b9759158f: Trout use raceways supplied by the cool spring; carp use the earthen pond; tilapia use a recirculating system heated to 27 °C in a greenhouse. The game rejects incompatible stockings. Air temperature differs from water temperature: each facility has its own thermal inertia.
m_c6c50a2ddd: Scheduling a ration reserves feed for the next 24 hours. The recommendation depends on weight, species, temperature and water conditions. Growth comes from consumed feed divided by a nominal FCR, then limited by conditions. Automatic feeding recalculates each day. Excess feed adds to the pollutant load.
m_b6d976b815: Oxygen is measured in mg/L; flow in L/s; density in kg/m³. TAN means total ammonia nitrogen in mg N/L. NH₃-N is its un-ionised fraction, calculated from pH and temperature: these two measurements are not interchangeable. This scenario assumes buffered pH.
m_2d3cf29831: Increase flow and install aeration if oxygen falls. A biofilter takes 30 days to reach its simulated capacity. Removing sludge and replacing 30% of the water reduces the nitrogen load but does not instantly restore the batch’s health. The health index is not a veterinary diagnosis; diseases and medicines are not simulated.
m_cca898ca68: New juveniles are considered acclimated on arrival, then observed for 14 days. Observation in the pond does not replace genuine isolated quarantine. After harvest, the game reserves 7 days for cleaning and fallowing. Spring-fed raceways take 14 days to build, the earthen pond 21 days, and the greenhouse 45 days including commissioning.
m_da1348360d: The report separates €18/day of part-time labour from the first pond, then €10 per additional pond, €2.50/pond/day of maintenance, electricity at €0.22/kWh and a simplified water fee.
